ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 85% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the central fluke surface and 15% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at margins and insertion points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white interior; solid black pigmentation band along the trailing edge (approx. 10-20 pixel width); dense black mottling at the central notch and the base of the peduncle; scattered dark punctate spots on the lower left lobe quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth is significant relative to total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous fine-scale serration with frequent peaks (1-3 pixels high); heavily irregular and jagged topography at the distal tips due to epibiont clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outer lateral edges curving inward towards a slightly concave approach to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, high-texture brown/tan clusters (epibionts) at both distal tips; small circular white high-contrast spots visible on the dark pigmented area near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal grey linear marks (scratches) visible on the mid-to-lower left lobe surface, oriented roughly 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes, causing significant deviation from the natural smooth trailing edge line.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy epibiont load on the fluke tips creates a unique, highly irregular silhouette visible against the water background.
